title: Block Search Conditioned on Features for Sequential Quantum Data Encoding
abstract: arXiv:2611.27587v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sequential quantum data encoding is addressed through the joint selection of input features and encoding blocks within a fixed quantum register. At each step, a new feature, a block of operations, its placement, and its rotation weights are selected together from training data, extending the incremental construction of Q-FLAIR. With direct-loss selection (RAW), nine to twelve features were retained in four qubits across five new Bars and Stripes datasets. Under the same final calibration, mean changes relative to the calibrated Q-FLAIR reference were +5.53 percentage points in balanced accuracy, -15.83% in binary cross-entropy (BCE), and +7.79% in area under the ROC curve (AUC). The prespecified success criterion was met in four of five datasets and for the mean paired differences. These results were obtained by comparing complete procedures under a common cap of 32 operations.

translated_title: 面向顺序量子数据编码的特征条件化块搜索
translated_abstract: 本文通过在固定量子寄存器内联合选择输入特征与编码块来处理顺序量子数据编码问题。在每一步中，从训练数据中共同选择一个新特征、一个操作块、其放置位置及其旋转权重，从而扩展了Q-FLAIR的增量构建方法。采用直接损失选择（RAW）策略，在五个新的Bars and Stripes数据集上，四个量子比特中保留了九至十二个特征。在相同的最终校准条件下，相对于校准后的Q-FLAIR参考方法，平均变化为：平衡准确率提升5.53个百分点，二元交叉熵（BCE）降低15.83%，ROC曲线下面积（AUC）提升7.79%。五个数据集中的四个以及平均配对差异均满足预先设定的成功标准。这些结果是在统一的32个操作上限下，通过比较完整流程获得的。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种特征条件化的块搜索方法，在固定量子寄存器中逐步联合选择输入特征、操作块、放置位置与旋转权重以扩展Q-FLAIR，在Bars and Stripes数据集上显著提升了分类性能指标。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a feature-conditioned block search that incrementally and jointly selects input features, operation blocks, placements, and rotation weights within a fixed quantum register, extending Q-FLAIR and achieving notable performance gains on Bars and Stripes datasets.
